_comment: Large, generated, or externally-versioned inputs that the drivers in final_check/code/pipeline/ read or write, recorded here instead of being committed. Sizes and hashes were measured, not transcribed. sha256 is given for every single file at or under 100 MB; directories and the git clones carry a pinned commit instead.
generated_by: one-off script for the final_check/code/pipeline archival lane

entries.what: The live, unversioned working tree these drivers execute from. 'git rev-parse' here fails: not a git repository. Every queue script hardcodes it as C= and cd's into it, so the archived copies under final_check/code/pipeline/ run THIS tree's Python, not their own siblings.
entries.produced_by: hand-authored over 2026-08-05..08-10; the archived subset is copied into evaluation/final_check/code/pipeline/, evaluation/comparison/code/ and evaluation/ablation/code/
